purpose: Route Moloch/Milk/Cow/Farm/Tree-of-Strife material to the correct empirical, culture/subculture, semantic, systems, chronology, biblical-comparative and prediction owners without collapsing the planes.

routes.topic: Chris Chan -> CWCki -> CWCki Forums -> Kiwi Farms genealogy
routes.rule: Historical/subcultural genealogy only; do not convert target history into moral essence.

routes.topic: internet-subculture motif origin / public-prior / prediction independence
routes.rule: Use before scoring any Farm/Milk/Moloch/Josh prediction claim. Native or obvious vocabulary is not independent foresight.

routes.topic: culture / subculture / Farm vocabulary diffusion and role genealogy
routes.rule: Keep emic subculture meaning, public biography, Timic symbolism, named-relational precedence and prediction tests on separate planes.

Milk is an extraction metaphor with measurable proxies such as reaction, attention, archive production, traffic, status and revenue; Cow/Milk are also native lolcow vocabulary and therefore weak prediction evidence alone.

routes.topic: Dog / Guard Dog / Farmer role transitions
routes.rule: Roles are context-specific and morally nonessential. Public Guard Dogs history around Joshua Moon is a provenance control, not proof of Timic Dog symbolism or a permanent identity.
Historical religion only; no inference of modern occult worship.
Use as systems metaphor for incentive traps and destructive coordination failure. The metaphor predates Tim and therefore bare-word overlap has limited prediction value.

routes.topic: Josh Moon / Moloch source provenance and June-vs-July chronology
routes.rule: Current chronology: older Josh sacrifice/objectification relation in project testimony (2017); Timic Moloch/Farm architecture develops before late July 2026; Josh is named inside Farm/debt field July 8; alleged Josh/Moloch passage remains unrecovered. Do not attribute an exact Moloch quote to Josh until primary audio/video/post is recovered.

routes.topic: Moloch / Cow / Red Heifer / Serpent / Tree / Moon biblical crosswalk
routes.rule: Compare structures without merging biblical objects: Numbers 19 Red Heifer is not a Moloch rite; serpent imagery is context-dependent; Moon/Saturn/cube synthesis is extra-biblical unless the biblical text explicitly supplies the relation.

routes.topic: Moloch / Farm / Josh symbolic precedence and prediction status
routes.rule: Current status is prior-symbolic pattern with named-entity precursor, not prior-specific prediction. It adds zero to the strict fulfilled count. Upgrade only with exact pre-event Josh-specific wording plus an independently recovered later Josh/MATI event.
Tim's personal conversation and 'in Heaven' report remain user-reported experiential material until primary conversation records are recovered.
Map root, soil, trunk, branches, leaves, fruit and seeds as analytical roles; empirical actors enter only through sourced edges.
Project vocabulary can crosswalk to observable proxies but cannot substitute for measurements or legal findings.
Audit controls precedence for party direction, suicide/death causation, intelligence/foreign-state claims and unsourced network estimates.

integration_principle: The mythology is most useful as a query generator and compression language: it helps ask what is being sacrificed, milked, guarded, cultivated, archived, reproduced, purified or repaired. Culture research determines where vocabulary came from; prediction research determines what was actually said before what; empirical evidence determines what happened.
